svg.text: C4 Code: DSP caller authentication with DCP
Who calls a DSP endpoint, checked with DCP, and the caller's credentials when a policy asks for them
Middleware on every DSP route: runs the
verifier on the Authorization header, or
DSP handlers: when an offer or agreement has
credential constraints, they ask for those
credentials; a failed query gives none
verify: who calls, with which credentials.
credentials: more scopes for a policy
DCP v1.0.1: checks the caller's self-issued ID
token, asks its Credential Service for
only credentials from trusted issuers, requires a
Our ID token, carrying the caller's access
DID documents of callers and issuers,
Signed with the caller's key, aud is
us, iss = sub, not expired, jti used
Signatures, holder is the caller, valid
now; the status list bit: not revoked
The configured credential types and the
Do the permissions hold now for this caller:
dateTime and credential constraints; anything not
Check the offer or the agreement before they
C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. One credential that fails its checks makes its whole presentation invalid, and the caller is refused (DCP 5.4.3).
